# ICPay

> Fast, secure multi-token wallet, decentralized cloud storage, and DEX trading platform built on the Internet Computer (ICP).

ICPay provides seamless payments using Internet Identity, decentralized file storage (ICPay Bucket), gasless cross-chain assets, token launchpads, and decentralized swap operations.

## Core Products & Features

- [Dashboard](https://icpay.app/): Main application dashboard for sending, receiving, and managing ICP and ICRC tokens.
- [Wallet](https://icpay.app/wallet): Multi-token wallet management, address book, subaccounts, and transaction history.
- [Bucket Cloud Storage](https://icpay.app/bucket): Decentralized, encrypted-at-rest file storage and global CDN hosting on the Internet Computer.
- [Swap & DEX Trading](https://icpay.app/trade): Instant decentralized token swaps and limit orders via ICPSwap integration.
- [Token Launcher](https://icpay.app/token/create): Launch custom ICRC-1 / ICRC-2 tokens on the Internet Computer in one click.
- [Canister Manager](https://icpay.app/canister): Deploy, monitor cycles, snapshot, and manage ICP canisters.
- [Community Channels](https://icpay.app/channels): On-chain community channels and token-gated discussions.
- [ICPay Presale & Tokenomics](https://icpay.app/icpay): ICPAY utility token details, distribution, and presale allocation.

## Developer Documentation & APIs

- [Bucket API & SDK Documentation](https://icpay.app/bucket/docs): REST and TypeScript SDK integration guide for ICPay Cloud Bucket.
- [Storage Pricing & Tiers](https://icpay.app/bucket/pricing): Transparent 30-day billing breakdown for storage tiers (1 GB, 2 GB, 3 GB).
- [API Authentication Guide](https://icpay.app/bucket/docs/api/auth): How to generate and authenticate with Bucket API keys.
- [Canister Top-up & Cycles Guide](https://icpay.app/topup): Cycles ledger top-up and conversion instructions.
